data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged and returns encoded train as (features, labels, user_ids), encoded valid as (features, labels, user_ids), and encoded test as (features, user_ids). Each features matrix has columns in canonical order [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday], where hour is floor(numeric hourmin / 100) constrained to 0..23 and weekday is the calendar weekday derived from YYYYMMDD date with Monday=0 through Sunday=6. Encodings and vocabularies are fit from training data only; canonical source row order is preserved.

model_input.description: model.py Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2) consumes a two-dimensional encoded integer feature matrix with at least five columns; it uses features[:, :5] for additive ID terms and encoded columns 2, 3, and 4 for the nonlinear context residual. The residual has three existing context embeddings, a ReLU hidden layer of exactly 8 units, and the existing scalar output head. predict(features) returns one float32 score per input row in input order.
